name: Writing and Editing [Basic]
description: This course introduces students to the fundamentals of writing- understanding the process, planning, developing arguments, drafting, revising, and finalizing. Students will learn how to construct coherent, persuasive, and well-structured writeups suitable for academic purposes. The course emphasizes clarity, logical argumentation, grammar, and proper referencing.
